reuse.why: Extends the shared getScheduleAmount and replaces api-models' private copy with it, but computes the 7.5% tolerance inline instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: Removes the duplicated getExpectedScheduleAmount in api-models.ts; the only new duplication is the tolerance formula already defined by getApproxNumberThreshold.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts getScheduleAmount, which preview, forecast, action sync, posting and now the API model all use.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule and its callers; the call-site comments that still describe only ranged amounts were left stale.

maintainability.why: Single shared function with an op parameter is easy to own; the inline tolerance can drift from the matching tolerance in shared/rules.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduleAmount: `Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075)` instead of getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The getApproxNumberThreshold formula is restated inline in getScheduleAmount under the name `tolerance`.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduleAmount(amount, amountOp), called by computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, normalizeSchedule, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and scheduleModel.toExternal.
